title: Mandir Patotsav & Sharad Purnima - Akshar Jayanti
description: Mandir Patotsav marks the anniversary of the temple's consecration.
long_description:
Mandir Patotsav marks the anniversary of the temple's consecration. This special celebration includes elaborate prayers (pujas), devotional music, cultural performances, and festive community gathering commemorating the sacred occasion of the temple's establishment.

This celebration takes place at BAPS Cincinnati in Cincinnati, OH. All are welcome.
